apps/worker/src/lonora_worker/__init__.p.name: Worker package
apps/worker/src/lonora_worker/__init__.p.description: Marks the always-on worker's code as one package; holds no logic of its own.

apps/worker/src/lonora_worker/health.py.name: Worker health
apps/worker/src/lonora_worker/health.py.description: Reports whether the worker is healthy.

apps/worker/src/lonora_worker/main.py.name: Worker startup
apps/worker/src/lonora_worker/main.py.description: Starts the always-on worker and keeps it running until it is told to stop; if its work loop freezes for two minutes, it records where it was stuck and exits so it is started again.

apps/worker/src/lonora_worker/process_id.name: Worker id
apps/worker/src/lonora_worker/process_id.description: Gives the worker process a unique id.

apps/worker/src/lonora_worker/signals.py.name: Stop signals
apps/worker/src/lonora_worker/signals.py.description: Lets the worker shut down cleanly when the system asks it to stop.
